scope: Primary arXiv abstract metadata and selected methods passages for three citations; no numerical replication, full-paper audit, code audit, or peer-review verification.

papers.title: LLM2Jev: LLMs Are Already Jev-Style Decision Models -- When and How to Fine-Tune Them
papers.metadata_location: Title/authors and submission history, extracted lines 8–27
papers.verified_scope: Frozen inference sums token log-probabilities for each bracketed numeric suffix, then normalizes across candidates. It reuses prompt KV state for parallel branch scoring. A separate fine-tuning recipe uses a tree-factorized loss and KL anchors. Inference omits permutation averaging.
papers.comparison_inference: A close frozen-readout comparator, but its full-suffix scoring can require branch forwards beyond the prompt prefill. Single-token and suffix scoring are distinct conditions.
papers.publication_status: arXiv preprint; no peer-reviewed venue verified in the checked primary metadata

papers.title: AnyJev Technical Report
papers.metadata_location: Title/authors/comments and submission history, extracted lines 8–27
papers.verified_scope: The report uses restricted single-token readout, estimates label priors from unlabelled inputs, and studies cyclic log-probability aggregation with position-bound labels. Eq. 3 averages pre-prior probabilities in log space; it does not apply per-layout prior correction first. Prior strength was selected with labels, and confidence temperature fitting is a separate labelled step.
papers.comparison_inference: Contrast log-space aggregation with LogitTrail's arithmetic probability mean and fixed token–meaning bindings. Adaptive stopping targets agreement with the full-cycle decision, not gold accuracy.
papers.publication_status: Early arXiv technical report; no peer-reviewed venue verified in the checked primary metadata

papers.title: AudioJev: Direct Audio Decisions with Order-Calibrated Probabilities
papers.metadata_location: Title/authors and submission history, extracted lines 8–26
papers.verified_scope: A trained audio classifier uses candidate-only logits and supervised random-derangement pairs. It aligns distributions by answer meaning before symmetric KL, updates all active classification parameters, and uses one forward at inference. Its order-consistency objective is separate from empirical confidence reliability.
papers.comparison_inference: Relevant to semantic alignment and order sensitivity; it is not a frozen text baseline. Position-relative alternatives fall outside its permutation-bias comparison domain.
papers.publication_status: arXiv preprint; no peer-reviewed venue verified in the checked primary metadata
